T-005.label: not_applicable

T-009.label: not_applicable

T-010.label: not_applicable

T-012.label: applicable_enforced
T-012.reason: ERC20Permit builds an EIP-712 digest with a nonce (L~50) and a deadline check (L~40), over EIP712's domain separator carrying chainId and address(this)

T-013.label: applicable_enforced
T-013.reason: uses ECDSA.recover, which reverts on a malformed signature and rejects high-s

T-014.label: not_applicable
T-014.reason: no transfer hooks in this composition

T-011.label: unclear
T-011.reason: ERC20Pausable overrides _update with whenNotPaused (L~28), so a pause halts every transfer. Whether that strands funds depends on the pause authority, which this mixin does not define

T-001.label: applicable_absent
T-001.reason: transfer, transferFrom and approve are declared with no return value (L85, L95, L96) and the implementations return nothing (L126, L171, L199). This is the canonical non-compliant token that broke integrators

T-002.label: applicable_absent
T-002.reason: approve requires the allowance be zeroed first (L~200), which mitigates the race but is itself the behaviour that breaks safeApprove integrations

T-003.label: applicable_enforced
T-003.reason: transferFrom checks the allowance before decrementing

T-004.label: unclear
T-004.reason: onlyPayloadSize(2*32) at L126 constrains calldata length; zero-value transfer is not explicitly rejected but the modifier has broken integrators historically

T-005.label: applicable_absent
T-005.reason: basisPointsRate at L110 and the fee computed at L127 and L177 mean the recipient receives less than the amount sent. The rate is currently zero, but the mechanism is present and the obligation is unmet by construction

T-007.label: applicable_enforced
T-007.reason: decimals is a constructor parameter and USDT deploys with 6; SafeMath is used throughout

T-008.label: applicable_enforced
T-008.reason: issue and redeem adjust totalSupply alongside the owner balance

T-010.label: applicable_enforced
T-010.reason: redeem is onlyOwner and burns only from the owner balance

T-011.label: applicable_absent
T-011.reason: addBlackList plus destroyBlackFunds permanently removes a holder's balance with no recovery path, and pause halts all transfers indefinitely

T-015.label: applicable_absent
T-015.reason: the upgrade path forwards to UpgradedStandardToken by legacy call rather than a proxy, and deprecation is irreversible once set

T-001.label: applicable_enforced

T-005.label: applicable_absent
T-005.reason: transfer takes a token amount, converts to shares via getSharesByPooledEth, and rounding means the recipient can receive one wei less than sent. Documented at L340-342 with a RoundUp variant provided

T-006.label: applicable_absent
T-006.reason: balanceOf returns getPooledEthByShares(_sharesOf(account)) at L178, so every holder's balance changes when the pool rebases, with no transfer occurring. This is the defining rebasing case and the obligation not to assume constant balances is unmet by design
